# grail-layers

> Every grail (Brainstem kernel) update ships as a layer over the unchanged grail; if a layer fails, plain grail runs.

- [Install (grail, then layers)](https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/install.sh | bash`
- [Uninstall (plain grail)](https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/uninstall.sh)
- [Supervisor](https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/grail_layers.py)
- [The pattern and the layer contract](https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/README.md)
- [Layer files in RAR](https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/stacks/grail-layers/pack.json)
- [Registry](https://kody-w.github.io/grail-layers/registry.json)
